mapper.select: SELECT pl.id, pl.no, pl.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS userName, pl.prize_id AS prizeId, pm.name AS prizeName, pl.lottery_time AS lotteryTime, pl.cost_point AS costPoint, pl.status, pl.send_time AS sendTime, pl.sender_id AS senderId, pl.check_result AS checkResult, pl.sync_status AS syncStatus, pl.create_time AS createTime FROM point_lottery pl LEFT JOIN user_info u ON pl.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN prize_mgmt pm ON pl.prize_id = pm.id AND pm.deleted = 0 WHERE pl.id = #{id} AND pl.deleted = 0
